title: MEGATRANS
description: megatrans.com.ar Megatrans S.A. is an Argentine road freight and logistics company founded in 1991 in Lanús, Buenos Aires, with 35 years of experience in general, heavy and dangerous goods transportation across Argentina and Mercosur. With over 200 employees and a fleet of 150 plus trucks, it operates regional terminals in Rosario, Córdoba, Neuquén and Mendoza with GPS-tracked vehicles. Its specialized services include ADR-certified dangerous goods transport for chemical, pharmaceutical and oil and gas industries alongside food and automotive logistics. The company holds CNRT and RUTA Seguro 837 certifications and provides full-cycle logistics including warehousing, customs clearance and insurance. International routes cover Brazil, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay and Bolivia. Major clients include YPF, BASF, Arcor, Toyota Argentina, Carrefour and Techint.
